description: This file contains shell functions related to firmware upgrade procedures, specifically for handling partition checking, upgrading, and copying configuration on AP821XX-based devices. It includes functions for platform validation and performing image-based upgrades with partition management.

methods.name: mbl_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks the device's partition layout for changes and prepares for firmware upgrade.

methods.name: mbl_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade by writing the new image to the device's partitions, handling partition comparison, and copying partition UUID.

methods.name: mbl_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the device's partition.
